title: DSDN: dual-head pomegranate fruit health screening and disease typing (code, data splits and results)
description: Code, data splits, training logs and per-image outputs for the Dual-head Screening and Diagnosis Network (DSDN): a shared EfficientNet-B0 backbone with a binary health-screening head and a five-class disease-typing head, evaluated on a public pomegranate fruit disease dataset. Includes the duplicate and acquisition audit, the fruit-grouped split, five-fold cross-validation, ablations, nine baselines, loss-weight sensitivity, linear probing, Grad-CAM++ concentration analysis and an evaluation without retraining on two labeled external datasets. Image datasets are not redistributed.
